2. Mention software requirement template IEEE.
3. Why does the GORE use (Enlist 5 reasons).

2. Triggers of state machine.

3. Why GORE (Goal Oriented Requirement Engineering) is used.

Questions:

2. Main constraints of feasibility.
3. Name 4 cognitive requirement techniques.
4. Write three disadvantages of brainstorming.
